entries.value: Louis Michel Chablis 2023 is Chardonnay from village Chablis, at the northern tip of Burgundy, where cool weather and chalky clay make a lean, mineral wine; 2023 was a big harvest, fruitier and more open than most years. The domaine makes it in steel tanks with no oak, so it tastes of the place: green apple, lemon, white flowers and an oyster-shell finish. Raw oysters are its classic match, so pour it with the Grand Isle Jewel Oysters and their chili mignonette; its acidity also meets the lemon and capers of the Swordfish Grenobloise. We serve it at 48 to 52°F, iced between pours. The domaine dates to 1850.
